patch.summary: AWeber migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to AWeber by inventorying legacy email-marketing fields, mapping them to AWeber objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating WordPress, Shopify, Stripe before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps
Success signal: email campaigns works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: AWeber migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power email campaigns, newsletter builder, email templates and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into AWeber; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate WordPress; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Creators and solopreneurs needing email + landing pages + basic funnels outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps
If AWeber mapping is poor, compare destination fit with GetResponse before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire WordPress in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Lite caps lists, LPs, automations, users, and segments vs Plus

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Marketing pricing page emphasizes Lite/Plus/Done For You; Unlimited details live primarily in docs

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for email campaigns
Mitigate: Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps

notes: Migration: cutover risks, data mapping, checklist.
